beginner.summary: For developers and data engineers who know Java or SQL and are new to stream processing. Covers a local Flink 2.x cluster, the DataStream API, keyed state, event time and watermarks, windows, late data, checkpoints and savepoints, reading and writing Kafka with the Flink connectors, Flink SQL and the Table API, job submission with the CLI and REST API, testing and metrics, and a clickstream analytics capstone.
prerequisites: Writes working Java programs with Maven or Gradle, or has strong SQL skills and basic Java
Uses a terminal and Docker confidently
Has Java 17, Docker and an IDE installed on a laptop with at least 8 GB of memory
outcomes: Run, configure and monitor a Flink 2.x cluster and submit jobs from the CLI and REST API
Build DataStream jobs with keyed state, event-time windows, watermarks and late data handling
Write Flink SQL queries with time attributes, window table-valued functions and Kafka and file connectors
Make jobs fault tolerant with checkpoints and savepoints and test them with unit and integration tests
